exam: Assam Police SI Combined Written Test (CWT-2025) Paper-I
paper: Paper-I (General Knowledge, Reasoning, Maths, English) - Booklet Code A
board: State Level Police Recruitment Board (SLPRB), Assam

questions.q: What is the name of the only novel written by Roxoraj Lakshminath Bezbaruah?
questions.e: Padum Kunwari (1891) is the only novel written by Lakshminath Bezbaruah; his other famous works are mostly short stories and plays.

questions.q: Remote sensing involves the use of
questions.e: Remote sensing works by detecting electromagnetic radiation (EMR) reflected or emitted from objects on the Earth's surface.

questions.q: Which film by Dr. Bhabendranath Saikia is based on a short story, namely Banaprastha ?
questions.e: Bhabendranath Saikia's debut film Sandhya Raag (1977) was adapted from his own short story 'Banaprastha'.

questions.q: Who first discovered the ‘noble gas’?
questions.e: Sir William Ramsay (with Lord Rayleigh) discovered argon and went on to identify the other noble gases, earning the 1904 Nobel Prize.

questions.q: Who was the first Chief Election Commissioner of Independent India?
questions.e: Sukumar Sen served as India's first Chief Election Commissioner (1950-58) and conducted the first two general elections.

questions.q: Who became the first woman President of the Indian Olympic Association?
questions.e: P. T. Usha was elected unopposed in December 2022 as the first woman President of the Indian Olympic Association.

questions.q: Which of the following is used as a lubricant?
questions.e: Graphite has layers held by weak forces that slide over each other, so it is used as a dry lubricant.

questions.q: In which year did the Government of India launch the Unified Payments Interface or UPI?
questions.e: UPI was launched by NPCI in April 2016 under the RBI's guidance.

questions.q: By what name was Swargadeo Sulikphaa (Swargadeo Ratnadhwaj Singha) known as?
questions.e: Sulikphaa (Ratnadhwaj Singha) became Ahom king as a boy, so he is remembered as 'Lora Roja' (boy king).

questions.q: Who is the first Olympic medalist of Assam?
questions.e: Boxer Lovlina Borgohain won bronze at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, becoming Assam's first Olympic medallist.

questions.q: Lightyear is the unit of
questions.e: A light-year is the distance light travels in one year (about 9.46 × 10^12 km), so it is a unit of distance.

questions.q: Which is the largest tributary of the Brahmaputra River?
questions.e: The Subansiri, entering Assam from Arunachal Pradesh, is the largest tributary of the Brahmaputra.

questions.q: The unique title ‘Roxoraj’ was given to Lakshminath Bezbaruah by which institution?
questions.e: Asam Sahitya Sabha conferred the title 'Roxoraj' on Lakshminath Bezbaruah at its Sibsagar session in 1931.

questions.q: The Chipko Movement was launched for the protection of
questions.e: The Chipko Movement (1973, Uttarakhand) saw villagers hug trees to stop forests being felled.

questions.q: Who is the founding father of Mobile Theatre in Assam?
questions.e: Achyut Lahkar founded Nataraj Theatre in 1963 and is regarded as the father of Assam's mobile theatre (Bhramyaman).

questions.q: The green planet in the solar system is
questions.e: Methane in Uranus's atmosphere absorbs red light, giving it a blue-green colour, so it is called the green planet.

questions.q: What was the name of the Mascot of 33rd National Games held in Guwahati?
questions.e: The mascot of the 33rd National Games (Guwahati, 2007) was 'Rongmon', a cheerful rhinoceros.

questions.q: Which of the following is the plant important in sericulture?
questions.e: Silkworms (Bombyx mori) feed on mulberry leaves, making mulberry the key plant in sericulture.

questions.q: ‘Lachit Diwas’ is being celebrated on which date?
questions.e: Lachit Diwas is observed on 24 November, the birth anniversary of Ahom general Lachit Borphukan.

questions.q: Who has the power to dissolve the Lok Sabha?
o: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
questions.e: Under Article 85(2)(b), the President can dissolve the Lok Sabha (normally on the advice of the Prime Minister).

questions.q: The best cadet of the National Defence Academy (Pune) is awarded with a medal named after which brave son of Assam?
questions.e: The Lachit Borphukan Gold Medal is given to the best passing-out cadet of the NDA since 1999.

questions.q: Name the two foreign countries which have international border with Assam.
questions.e: Assam shares international borders with Bhutan (north) and Bangladesh (south-west).

questions.q: Which politician is known as the ‘Iron Man’ of Assam?
questions.e: Bishnuram Medhi, Assam's second Chief Minister, is popularly called the 'Iron Man of Assam'.

questions.q: Which among the following is the smallest unit in an image in a computer system?
questions.e: A pixel (picture element) is the smallest addressable unit of a digital image.

questions.q: What is ‘laughing gas’?
questions.e: Nitrous oxide (N2O) causes mild euphoria when inhaled, hence the name laughing gas.

questions.q: If Discus Throw is called Shot Put, Shot Put is called Javelin Throw, Javelin Throw is called Hammer Throw and Hammer Throw is called Discus Throw, then which athletic event is played with a pointed equipment?
questions.e: The pointed equipment is the javelin; since Javelin Throw is called Hammer Throw, the answer is Hammer Throw.

questions.q: A cloth shop has a total of 150 frocks and shirts, which are either red or blue. In stock, there are 70 red items and 120 frocks. If there are 18 blue shirts, then how many red frocks does the shop have?
questions.e: Shirts = 150 - 120 = 30, so red shirts = 30 - 18 = 12; red frocks = 70 - 12 = 58.

questions.q: How many two-digit natural numbers are there between 1 and 100?
questions.e: Two-digit numbers run from 10 to 99, giving 99 - 10 + 1 = 90 numbers.

questions.q: A chord of a circle is drawn whose length is equal to its radius. If the endpoints of the chord are joined to the centre of the circle with appropriate line segments, the triangle formed is a/an
questions.e: Both radii and the chord are equal in length, so all three sides are equal: an equilateral triangle.

questions.q: In a meeting, five persons assembled and every person shook hand with every other exactly once. The total number of handshakes made in the meeting is
questions.e: Handshakes among 5 people = 5C2 = 5 × 4 / 2 = 10.

questions.q: Let a year consist of 364 days. If the first day of the given year falls on Sunday, then the first day of the immediate next year is
questions.e: 364 days = exactly 52 weeks with no odd day, so the next year also starts on Sunday.

questions.q: Which one of the following is not a perfect square number?
questions.e: 3721 = 61², 1296 = 36², 1369 = 37²; 1026 ends in 6 but lies between 32² = 1024 and 33² = 1089, so it is not a square.

questions.q: A discount of 20% is offered on the selling price of an item. By what percentage the price needs to be increased on the present selling price in order to bring it to the original selling price?
questions.e: If price falls by 20% to 80, raising it back to 100 needs 20/80 × 100 = 25% increase.

questions.q: 5 hens lay eggs everyday for 5 days to the total 250 number of eggs. Then the number of eggs laid by the 10 hens in 10 days is
questions.e: Each hen lays 250/(5×5) = 10 eggs a day; 10 hens × 10 days × 10 = 1000 eggs.

questions.q: Kanika’s only brother Abhay is the husband of Ujjwal’s mother Kajol. How is Kanika’s mother Rajni related to Ujjwal?
questions.e: Abhay is Ujjwal's father and Kanika's brother, so their mother Rajni is Ujjwal's father's mother: paternal grandmother.

questions.q: In a certain code, ‘247’ means ‘spread red carpet’; ‘256’ means ‘dust one carpet’ and ‘264’ means ‘one red carpet’. Which digit in the code means ‘dust’?
questions.e: 'carpet' is common to all and is 2; 'one' is common to the 2nd and 3rd (6); so in 256, 'dust' = 5.

questions.q: ABCD is a 4-digit number where the sum of A and B is equal to that of the sum of C and D. The sum of A and D is equal to C, and the sum of B and D is twice the sum of A and C. What is the sum of the first and the last digit?
questions.e: From the conditions B = 2D and D = 4A, so A = 1, B = 8, C = 5, D = 4 (number 1854); first + last digit = 1 + 4 = 5.

questions.q: Few cyclists are pedalling in a circular track, without overtaking. Tapan is behind Pawan, and Vinita is in front of Pawan. Vinita can see two cyclists between herself and Shalini who is following Tapan. How many cyclists are there on the track?
questions.e: Behind Vinita come Pawan, Tapan and Shalini; looking ahead around the circle she sees two more riders before Shalini, so 4 + 2 = 6 cyclists.

questions.q: The direction pointer at a road crossing got hit by a truck, and what was earlier East is now pointing towards South. A car came and started moving towards West as per the pointer. Which direction is the car actually moving?
questions.e: The pointer turned 90° clockwise (E shows S), so its 'West' actually points North.

questions.q: A man is 24 years older than his son. After 2 years, his age will be twice the age of his son. The present age of his son is
questions.e: Let son = x: x + 24 + 2 = 2(x + 2) gives x = 22 years.

questions.q: How many times do the hands of a clock coincide in a day?
questions.e: The hands coincide 11 times in 12 hours, hence 22 times in a day.

questions.q: A bag contains 50 paise, 25 paise and 10 paise coins and the ratio of the numbers of coins is 4 : 5 : 9. If the total value of all the coins is ₹830, then find the number of 25 paise coins in the bag.
The radius of a sphere is increased by 10%. By what percentage will the volume of the sphere increase?
questions.e: Volume ∝ r³: 1.1³ = 1.331, an increase of 33.1%.

questions.q: If we represent the relationship as: A + B indicates A is the mother of B; A − B indicates A is the father of B; A × B indicates A is the sister of B; then which of the following indicates that Jane is the daughter of Mr. Bennet?
questions.e: Mr. Bennet − Elizabeth means he is her father, and Elizabeth × Jane means Elizabeth is Jane's sister, so Jane is his daughter.

questions.q: A rectangular plot measuring 90 metres × 50 metres is to be enclosed by wire fencing. If the poles of the fence are kept 5 metres apart, then how many poles will be needed?
questions.e: Perimeter = 2(90 + 50) = 280 m; poles on a closed boundary = 280/5 = 56.

questions.q: Among five friends, Mahesh is taller than Kunal but not as tall as Yash. Hrithik is taller than Yash but shorter than Abhishek. If they stand in increasing order of their heights, then who will be the first in the line?
questions.e: Order of height: Kunal < Mahesh < Yash < Hrithik < Abhishek, so Kunal is first in increasing order.

questions.q: The average of 7 consecutive numbers is 20. The largest of these numbers is
questions.e: Seven consecutive numbers with average 20 are 17 to 23; the largest is 23.

questions.q: Ramakanta walks Northwards. After a while, he turns to his right and a little further to his left. Finally, after walking a distance of one kilometre, he turns to his left again. In which direction is he moving now?
questions.e: North → right (East) → left (North) → left (West): he is now moving West.

questions.q: The fourth proportional to 5, 8, 15 is
questions.e: Fourth proportional = (8 × 15)/5 = 24.

questions.q: Arun and Barun can do a piece of work in 72 days. Barun and Gitu can do it in 120 days. Arun and Gitu can do it in 90 days. In what time can Arun alone do it?
What is the appropriate number to replace the question mark (?) in the following expression? C : 16 :: E : 36 :: G : ?
questions.e: C is the 3rd letter, (3+1)² = 16; E is 5th, (5+1)² = 36; G is 7th, (7+1)² = 64.

questions.q: E is the son of A. D is the son of B. E is married to C. C is B ’s daughter. How does D relate to E ?
questions.e: C is B's daughter and D is B's son, so D is C's brother; C is E's wife, so D is E's brother-in-law.

questions.q: An equilateral triangle, a square and a circle have equal perimeter. If T denotes the area of the triangle, S the area of the square and C the area of the circle, then
questions.e: For a fixed perimeter, area increases with more symmetry: triangle < square < circle.

questions.q: What should come in the place of question mark (?) ? CBD, GFH, KJL, ? , SRT
questions.e: First letters C, G, K, O, S increase by 4; each group is (n, n−1, n+1), giving ONP.

questions.q: A boy moves from his house to school at the speed of 20 km/hr and returns back at the speed of 30 km/hr. Find his average speed during his journey.
questions.e: Average speed for equal distances = 2 × 20 × 30 / (20 + 30) = 24 km/h.

questions.q: On 8th February, 2005, it was Tuesday. What was the day of the week on 8th February, 2004?
questions.e: 2004 was a leap year and 29 Feb 2004 lies between the dates, so going back 366 days shifts the day back by 2: Sunday.

questions.q: The largest number of four digits exactly divisible by 12, 15, 18 and 27 is
questions.e: LCM(12,15,18,27) = 540; the largest 4-digit multiple is 540 × 18 = 9720.

questions.q: The average of runs of a cricket player of his last 10 innings was 32. How many runs must he make in his next innings so as to increase his average of runs by 4?
questions.e: New total = 11 × 36 = 396; runs needed = 396 − 320 = 76.

questions.q:
Passage: Lionel Messi could not believe it. Frankly, few could. Against the US four days ago, his divine left foot had made the ball overcome a wall of defenders and curl and dip past a diving goalkeeper to magically settle in the top left corner of the goal. It was not as much a free kick from 25 yards, but a laser-guided missile. On Sunday night, in the penalty shootout of the Copa America final against Chile, he hit it over from less than half that distance with nothing but the thick New Jersey air to beat. The resultant 4–2 loss meant Argentina’s title drought, dating back to 1993, would continue. It also ensured that Messi, one of the most decorated club footballers of all time, would not get that one trophy with the national team he so covets. It will remain that way as Messi, later, announced his retirement from international football. His teammates have said it was a heat-of-the-moment decision and he would reconsider. Messi’s unhappiness with the Argentine Federation, which is teetering on the brink of collapse, may also have influenced his decision. Therefore, a return to sky blue-and-white, with the World Cup just two years away, cannot be implausible. Nevertheless, if Sunday was his final appearance for Albiceleste, what legacy does he leave behind? It is easy to brand him as an underachiever, given his 28–0 club vs. country record at the senior level. But the picture is more complex. For one, modern-day football has very limited scope for independent, individual flair. Two, what that number does not show is both as a player and a captain, Messi has been instrumental in Argentina making it to three major finals in the last two years, including the 2014 World Cup. What remains unquestionable is Messi’s unimpeachable genius. His unparalleled vision, deft touch, and nimble footwork have often proved to be the lifeline of his teams, be it at Barcelona or Argentina. Yes, he may have missed that crucial penalty, but it is important to remember that football is a team sport. It is equally about collective endeavour as it is about individual brilliance. Clearly, the margin between an underachiever and a GOAT is very, very slim. It, therefore, depends on how you want to remember Messi : Through his last miss or his last hit, that free kick.

Question: What does the author mean to say when he comments, “Lionel Messi could not believe it”?
o: Lionel Messi could not believe that he could not score a goal of a free kick during the penalty shootout
Lionel Messi could not believe that he had overcome a wall of defenders to score a goal from 25 yards
Lionel Messi could not believe that the football that he kicked from 25 yards hit the goals like a missile
Lionel Messi could not believe the ball that he kicked curved and settled in the top left corner of the goal
questions.e: The opening line refers to his disbelief at missing a short penalty in the shootout after scoring a superb long free kick days earlier.

o: It brought criticism for Messi from all around the world
It deprived his national football team of the Copa America Cup
It made Lionel Messi so dejected that he had to announce retirement from football

o: Messi has never won a major international trophy with Argentina.
Messi’s individual brilliance outweighs the importance of collective endeavour in football.
Messi’s missed penalty in the Copa America final was the sole reason for Argentina’s loss.

questions.q: Who shifted his capital from Chikangram to Cooch Behar?
questions.e: Biswa Singha, founder of the Koch kingdom, moved his capital from Chikangram to Cooch Behar.

questions.q: Name the place where Buddhists believe Gautama Buddha attained Parinirvana after his death.
questions.e: Buddha attained Mahaparinirvana at Kushinagar (in present-day Uttar Pradesh).

questions.q: Who was the court poet of Samudragupta?
questions.e: Harisena, Samudragupta's court poet, composed the Prayaga Prashasti on the Allahabad pillar.

questions.q: Aideu Handique, the first female actor of Assamese screen, adopted which of the following as her middle name?
questions.e: Aideu Handique, heroine of Joymoti (1935), took her father's name Nilambar as her middle name.

questions.q: In 1923, by whom was the Swaraj Party founded?
o: Motilal Nehru and C. R. Das
Abdul Ghaffar Khan and Vithalbhai Patel
questions.e: C. R. Das and Motilal Nehru founded the Swaraj Party in 1923 to contest council elections.

questions.q: What was the role of ‘Laimekuri’ in the kitchen of Ahom King?
questions.e: In the Ahom royal kitchen the Laimekuri tasted food first to guard the king against poisoning.

questions.q: Rabindranath Tagore renounced his Knighthood in protest against the
questions.e: Tagore returned his knighthood in 1919 in protest against the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

questions.q: The Battle of Samdhara was the first battle between Ahoms and Mughals. Which was the last battle between the both sides?
questions.e: The Battle of Itakhuli (1682) was the last Ahom-Mughal battle, after which the Mughals were driven beyond the Manas.

questions.q: The Labour Swaraj Party was set up by whom in 1925?
questions.e: Kazi Nazrul Islam helped form the Labour Swaraj Party of the Indian National Congress in Bengal in 1925.

questions.q: Koum Kontong and Kambang are the traditional dress for women of which tribe?
questions.e: Koum Kontong and Kambang are traditional garments worn by Rabha women.

questions.q: In which year was Nagaland bifurcated from Assam?
questions.e: Nagaland was carved out of Assam and became a state on 1 December 1963.

questions.q: Who established the Varman dynasty?
questions.e: Pushyavarman founded the Varman dynasty of Kamarupa in the 4th century CE.

questions.q: Who among the following was the first Governor-General of India?
questions.e: Under the Charter Act of 1833, Lord William Bentinck became the first Governor-General of India.

questions.q: Who was the first Muslim invader of Kamarupa?
questions.e: Muhammad Bakhtiyar Khalji led the first Muslim invasion of Kamarupa in about 1206 and was defeated.

questions.q: The word ‘Swaraj’ was first used by Dadabhai Naoroji in the Congress Session held in _____ at _____.
questions.e: Dadabhai Naoroji, presiding over the 1906 Calcutta session, first declared Swaraj as the Congress goal.

questions.q: Who was the father of King Harshavardhana?
questions.e: Harshavardhana was the son of Prabhakaravardhana of the Pushyabhuti dynasty of Thanesar.

questions.q: The Hindu Mahasabha was organized for the first time in 1915 at
questions.e: The All-India Hindu Mahasabha held its first session at Haridwar in 1915.

questions.q: Who rebuilt the temple of Goddess Kamakhya?
questions.e: Koch king Naranarayan rebuilt the Kamakhya temple in 1565 after its destruction.

questions.q: Who was the mother of Srimanta Sankardev?
questions.e: Srimanta Sankardev was born to Kusumbar Bhuyan and Satyasandhya Devi.

questions.q: Who among the following ambassadors of Queen Elizabeth visited Akbar’s court to obtain a Firman for trade in Gujarat?
questions.e: Englishman John Mildenhall reached Akbar's court around 1603 seeking trading rights.

questions.q: When and where was the first meeting of the Assam Association held?
questions.e: The Assam Association held its first meeting in 1905 at Dibrugarh.

questions.q: Who was the first Governor of independent Assam?
questions.e: Sir Akbar Hydari was the first Governor of Assam after independence (1947-48).

questions.q: Name the first man to oppose British administration in Assam.
questions.e: Gomdhar Konwar led the 1828 uprising, the first revolt against British rule in Assam.

questions.q: In which year did Alexander invade India?
questions.e: Alexander crossed into India and fought Porus at the Hydaspes in 326 BC.

questions.q: The famous ‘Trimurti Sadashiva’ is the part of which among the following caves in India?
questions.e: The Trimurti (Sadashiva) sculpture is in Cave 1 of the Elephanta Caves near Mumbai.

questions.q: Who was the first Editor of the Arunodoi ?
questions.e: Arunodoi (1846), the first Assamese periodical, was started by American Baptist missionary Dr. Nathan Brown.

questions.q: The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was associated with which of the following movements of India?
questions.e: The Gandhi-Irwin Pact (1931) suspended the Civil Disobedience Movement.

questions.q: Which Veda depicts the information about the most ancient Vedic age culture?
questions.e: The Rigveda is the oldest Veda and the main source on early Vedic culture.

questions.q: Whose birthday is celebrated as Abhiruchi Sports Day in Assam?
questions.e: Footballer Bhogeshwar Baruah's birthday (3 September) is observed as Abhiruchi Sports Day in Assam.

questions.q: Which party was established by Subhas Chandra Bose after he came out of the Indian National Congress?
questions.e: After leaving the Congress presidency, Subhas Chandra Bose formed the Forward Bloc in 1939.
